projects.title: Spacebar Server (Discord Backend Reimplementation)
projects.platform: Self-hosted server. Official setup docs provide Linux bare-metal npm modules, NixOS, and Docker installation paths and say Windows is not recommended. Node.js runs the primary TypeScript services; .NET is used for some C# utilities.
projects.status: GitHub records the latest source push on 2026-10-16; no GitHub releases are listed. The README says Spacebar aims to remain compatible with Discord clients, bots, and applications, while noting that client incompatibilities remain and some clients will not connect.
projects.summary: A self-hostable reimplementation and extension of the Discord backend. The source tree includes API request/response types, HTTP API, WebSocket gateway, CDN, WebRTC, database models, and C# administration/CDN utilities.
projects.strategy: Reverse engineers and independently reimplements Discord backend behavior and protocol-facing services, with additional features. Implements HTTP API, WebSocket gateway, CDN, WebRTC, and supporting models; compatibility is incomplete.
projects.source_available: Public source licensed AGPL-3.0-only (declared in package.json and COPYING). No releases are listed by the GitHub Releases API.

projects.title: Asahi Neural Engine Linux Driver
projects.game: Apple Neural Engine hardware access on Linux
projects.platform: Linux on systems with Apple Neural Engine hardware (Apple Silicon). The repository README does not specify a supported SoC/device matrix or hardware-test matrix.
projects.status: GitHub records the latest source push on 2024-03-12; the repository is not archived and has no GitHub releases. The README identifies the project as a reverse-engineered Linux driver and lists documentation as work in progress; it does not claim production readiness or name tested devices.
projects.summary: A reverse-engineered Linux driver stack for Apple Neural Engine hardware, with an out-of-tree kernel module, a C user-space library, and Python bindings.
projects.strategy: Reverse engineers Apple Neural Engine hardware behavior and implements a Linux kernel module plus user-space library and Python bindings. Scope is Linux device access; the README does not claim to reimplement Apple Core ML or its application frameworks.
projects.source_available: Public MIT-licensed source. The README says documentation is work in progress; no releases are listed.

projects.title: mkmsbr (Microsoft-Compatible Boot Record Reimplementation)
projects.game: Microsoft-compatible boot records for Windows installation media
projects.platform: Generates legacy-BIOS, MBR-partitioned Windows XP/7 installation media boot records. The README reports end-to-end Windows 7 USB boot on a Dell E6410 and real-hardware validation for several boot-record variants; UEFI is out of scope. The Rust CLI is published for macOS/Homebrew and crates.io, while host-platform compatibility is not exhaustively specified.
projects.status: v1.0.1 was released on 2026-05-19. The README reports end-to-end Windows 7 install-USB boot and real BIOS testing on a Dell E6410. MBR and FAT32 PBR variants are documented as shipped; the NTFS boot-manager PBR remains experimental and validated only at the QEMU smoke-test level. UEFI and a broader hardware matrix are out of scope for v1.0.
projects.summary: A clean-room Rust library and CLI that generates and splices Microsoft-compatible MBR, FAT32 PBR, and NTFS PBR boot records without depending on ms-sys. The project publishes its own NASM boot-code sources and documents QEMU, Microsoft-loader, and real-BIOS validation.
projects.strategy: Strict clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft-compatible boot-record behavior using Rust library/CLI code and x86 assembly. The project defines a provenance protocol and evaluates generated boot records against an ms-sys oracle, QEMU, Microsoft loaders, and physical legacy-BIOS hardware.
projects.source_available: Public MIT-licensed Rust and NASM source, with v1.0.1 library/CLI release. No Microsoft installation media or loader binaries are included in the repository; the README's real-loader fixtures are extracted from user-held ISO files into gitignored test storage.
projects.subtype: Clean-room legacy BIOS boot-record library and CLI
